adjudication.rationale: Verified in diff: CalendarManager.createEvent now accepts an optional `externalId` param and returns it in the result (`externalId, credentialId: credential.id` in packages/core/CalendarManager.ts). EventManager later writes booking reference fields from the createEvent result (`externalCalendarId: result.externalId` in packages/core/EventManager.ts). However, in EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents(), the fallback branch for destination calendars without `credentialId` calls `createEvent(c, event)` without passing any `externalId` (packages/core/EventManager.ts, inside `else { const destinationCalendarCredentials = ... map(async (c) => await createEvent(c, event)) }`). This means `result.externalId` will be undefined for those created events, so booking references will lose `externalCalendarId` despite a destination having `destination.externalId` available. Additionally, GoogleCalendarService.createEvent now selects the calendar by matching `cal.credentialId === credentialId`, so when destination entries lack credentialId it will not pick the intended externalId and will fall back to `primary`, aligning with the finding’s described behavior.
